about: Employed Abu Dhabi citizens about to marry apply for an interest-free marriage loan.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Citizens of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi who are employed in the country and about to marry
fees: No fees or interest; loan of up to AED 150,000
timing: Banking steps are completed through First Abu Dhabi Bank
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Abu Dhabi Social Support Authority
